Luoke First Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Telšių apskritis, Lithuania

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' Jews began settling in Luokė in the 17th century; a fire in 1887 and a pogrom sparked by a blood libel accusation in 1888 hit the community hard, driving emigration to America, South Africa, and Palestine. The population reached 798 (49 percent) by 1897. About 400 Jews lived in Luokė at the time of the 1941 German invasion; they were killed in the nearby camps of Gudiškė and Geruliai.
